verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that self-hosting is supported as of the 1.0 release and explain why developers may want it. The GitHub repo says functions can be synced to a self-hosted Inngest server, so the core engine can be run on your own infrastructure. Community commenters note the code is SSPL, which makes it source-available rather than OSI open source; this tempers the openness angle but does not contradict that self-hosting works. Missing for 10: detailed self-hosting deployment docs (backing stores, scaling, operations), evidence of feature parity with the hosted platform, and independent hands-on reports of running it self-hosted.
